blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Low-cost handheld ultrasound devices can be widely deployed compared to professional hospital ultrasound machines. However, their images suffer from compound degradation that can mislead clinical judgment. Motivated by this observation, mapping handheld low-quality (LQ) to hospital high-quality (HQ) images has been considered a valuable research question. Conventionally, the mapping requires pixel-aligned LQ–HQ pairs. This requirement is unsatisfactory in practical scenarios because real scans at different times are never pixel-aligned. This paper addresses the challenge with a two-stage framework. The first stage generates pixel-aligned LQ–HQ datasets, and the second stage trains an enhancement model that improves LQ images. The first stage trains a cycle-consistent style-transfer model on unaligned real LQ-HQ pairs to learn a HQ → \rightarrow LQ model. Then, the model transforms real HQ images into pixel-aligned LQ images. Based on the dataset generated by the first stage, the second stage uses the Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method to fine-tune an LQ → \rightarrow HQ model based on aligned pairs. In this stage, the model is based on the well known PiSA-SR framework but inserts a degradation-conditioned correction matrix.
Experimental results on the USenhance2023 dataset show that the FID metric is improved by 16.7% over the strongest baseline while other metrics indicate that our enhanced outputs are well aligned with the real HQ distribution. The source code of our method is available at https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LoRA .
blocks.zh:
与专业医院超声机相比,低成本的手持超声波设备可以被广泛部署. 然而,他们的图像受到复合降解的影响,这可能会误导临床判断. 基于这一观察,将手持的低质量(LQ)映射到医院的高质量(HQ)图像被认为是一个有价值的研究问题. 常规情况下,绘图需要像素对齐的LQQHQ配对. 这一要求在实际情景中不尽人意,因为不同时期的真正扫描从未像素对齐. 本文件以两个阶段的框架来讨论这一挑战。 第一阶段生成像素对齐的LQQHQ数据集,第二阶段培训改进LQ图像的增强模型. 第一阶段在不匹配的真LQ-HQ对上进行循环一致的风格转换模型,学习HQ →\右旋LQ模型. 随后,该模型将真实的HQ图像转换成像素对齐的LQ图像. 基于第一阶段生成的数据集,第二阶段采用双降解引导低Rank适应(LORA)方法,在对齐对齐的基础上微调LQ →\右旋HQ模型. 在这一阶段,该模型基于众所周知的PISA-SR框架,但插入一个降解条件的校正矩阵。
USenhance2023数据集的实验结果显示,FID度量比最强基线改进了16.7%,而其他度量度量则表明,我们增强的输出量与总部的实际分布非常一致。 我们方法的源代码见https://github.com/Jason0411202/DDG_LORA 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Handheld ultrasound devices have become the default imaging tool in rural hospitals and primary-care clinics where professional ultrasound machines are unavailable or too expensive [ 20 ] . Their images, however, are degraded by strong speckle noise, motion-like blur, and compressed contrast. In the natural-image domain, deep learning models [ 15 ] have demonstrated considerable success in generating high-quality (HQ) images from low-quality (LQ) inputs. This raises a natural question: could the advanced techniques improve handheld ultrasound quality enough to reduce the urgency of costly hardware upgrades?
blocks.zh: 手持超声波设备已成为农村医院和初级保健诊所的默认成像工具,那里没有专业的超声波机器或设备过于昂贵[20]. 然而,它们的图像被强烈的光谱噪声,运动状模糊,以及压缩的对比而退化. 在自然成像领域,深层学习模型[15]在通过低质量(LQ)输入生成高质量(HQ)图像方面表现出相当大的成功. 这自然提出了一个问题:先进的技术能否提高手持超声波的质量,以降低昂贵硬件升级的迫切性?

blocks.en: Supervised LQ → \rightarrow HQ enhancement requires pixel-aligned LQ–HQ pairs to train the enhancement model. However, scanning the same patient with both device types inevitably introduces differences in probe-angle and tissue-deformation. The LQ–HQ pairs are never pixel-aligned. Training an enhancement model with unaligned data makes the supervision signal inconsistent and leads to poor convergence. One natural approach is to synthesize aligned pairs by applying hand-crafted degradation to HQ images [ 14 ] . This approach ensures pixel-level alignment, but the degradation recipes are too idealized to reproduce what real handheld devices exhibit in practice. Another approach is physics-based simulation of the acoustic imaging process [ 6 ] . However, the dynamic and device-dependent factors make accurate simulation prohibitively complex.
blocks.zh: 监督的LQ →\右旋HQ增强需要像素对齐的LQQHQ配对来训练增强型号. 然而,用两种设备类型扫描同一个病人,必然会带来探针角和组织变形的差异. LQQHQ组合从未像素对齐. 培训一种数据不匹配的增强模型,使得监督信号不一致,导致趋同性差. 一个自然的方法是通过对总部的图像应用手动降解来合成对称配对[14]. 这种方法确保像素级的对齐,但降解配方过于理想化,无法复制真正的手持设备在实际中的表现. 另一种方法是基于物理学的声学成像过程模拟[6]. 然而,动态因素和依赖设备的因素使得准确的模拟极其复杂。

blocks.en: An alternative solution is to directly learn LQ → \rightarrow HQ enhancers from an unpaired dataset using a CycleGAN-style framework [ 21 ] . However, the generator must produce the HQ side without any real HQ supervision, which often results in unacceptable failures on medical images.
blocks.zh: 另一种解决办法是使用循环GAN式框架从未发售的数据集直接学习LQ →\右旋HQ增强器 [21]. 然而,发电机必须在没有任何总部真正监督的情况下生产总部一方,这往往导致医疗图像出现不可接受的故障。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Style-driven data synthesis pipeline. Stage 1 splits USenhance2023 into a 4:1 train/test partition (1), trains a style transfer model G G on unaligned real LQ–HQ pairs (2), applies G G to each real HQ image y i y_{i} to obtain a pixel-aligned LQ counterpart x ~ i \tilde{x}_{i} (3), and assembles the USenhance2023-Aligned dataset (4). Stage 2 trains the DDG-LoRA enhancer on this dataset (5).
blocks.zh: 图1:样式驱动数据合成管道. 第1阶段将USenhance2023拆分为4:1列车/测试分区(1),在不匹配的真LQQHQ配对上列车一种风格传动型号G(2),将GG应用到每个真实的HQ图像y y y i i i ),以获得像素对等的LQ对应器x ~ i\tilde{x}_{i}(3),并组装USenhance2023-Acenting数据集(4). 第2阶段在此数据集上对DDG-LORA增强器进行训练(5).

blocks.en: This paper proposes a two-stage framework that handles the alignment and domain-gap problems separately (Fig. 1 ). Stage one learns HQ → \rightarrow LQ from real unaligned LQ–HQ pairs to synthesize aligned pairs, and stage two then trains an LQ → \rightarrow HQ enhancement model on those pairs. In the first stage, we use a style-transfer CycleDiff [ 22 ] as the degrader. Unlike conventional CycleGAN that translates images through a single generator and tends to overfit individual data points rather than covering the full distribution of both domains, frequently causing structural distortion, CycleDiff integrates the translation process into a diffusion framework at a deeper level. A denoising network predicts the image component at each time step and helps to isolate the clean signal from the noisy input. Therefore, the synthesized LQ is pixel-aligned with the source HQ. Moreover, the HQ images themselves are never modified, so the supervision target remains real clinical data. This eliminates the hallucination risk inherent in methods that generate the HQ side directly.
blocks.zh: 本文件提出一个两阶段框架,分别处理对齐和域-差距问题(图1)。 第一阶段从真正的不对齐的LXQHQ对学习HQ →\右翼LQ,以合成对齐的对齐,第二阶段然后在这些对齐上训练一个LQ →\右翼HQ增强模型. 在第一阶段,我们使用一种风格转换循环Diff [22]作为降解器. 与常规的CycleGAN通过单个生成器翻译图像,并倾向于过度匹配单个数据点,而不是覆盖两个域的全部分布,经常造成结构扭曲不同,CycleDiff将翻译过程整合到更深层次的传播框架中. 一个调音网络在每一时段都会预测图像组件,并有助于将干净的信号与吵闹的输入隔开. 因此,合成的LQ与源HQ是像素对齐的. 此外,总部的图像本身也从未修改过,因此监督目标仍然是真实的临床数据. 这消除了直接产生总部一方的方法中固有的幻觉风险.

blocks.en: In the second stage, a LQ → \rightarrow HQ enhancer is trained from the data generated in stage one. The enhancer is expected not only to address denoising or sharpening, but also to improve speckle statistics and tissue-texture changes that are critical in ultrasound analysis. The requirements are far from what CNN-based SR models [ 10 ] can express. Therefore, this paper uses PiSA-SR [ 13 ] , which is a powerful framework, as the backbone for our enhancer. Its dual-LoRA design splits the conflicting objectives of low-level pixel fidelity and high-level semantic plausibility into two branches. However, PiSA-SR focuses on super resolution but is not designed to model complex degradation as seen in ultrasound images. Recently, a degradation-conditioned correction matrix was introduced in S3Diff [ 17 ] to model degradation effectively. Therefore, we integrate the concept of a degradation-conditioned correction matrix into PiSA-SR to train the enhancer. The combination of the degradation guide in S3Diff and the dual-LoRA PiSA-SR creates a Dual Degradation-Guided (DDG) LoRA method that enhances LQ images with complex speckle noise.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,从第一阶段生成的数据中培训了一名LQ +\右翼总部增强器。 预计增强器不仅可以处理去诺或磨损问题,而且可以改进对超声波分析至关重要的光谱统计和组织纹理变化。 要求远非基于CNN的SR模型[10]可以表达. 因此,本文使用PISA-SR [13],这是一个强大的框架,作为我们增强器的骨干. 其双层LORA设计将低等像素忠诚度和高等语义可信度等相互冲突的目标分为两个分支. 然而,PiSA-SR专注于超解析度,但并没有设计用于模拟超声波图像中看到的复杂降解. 最近,在S3Diff[17]中引入了具有降解条件的校正矩阵,以有效模拟降解. 因此,我们把具有降解条件的校正矩阵概念纳入PISA-SR,以培训增强器。 S3Diff中的降解指南和双层LORA PISA-SR的结合,形成了一种双降解Guided(DDG)LORA方法,用复杂的光谱噪声增强LQ图像.

blocks.en: In summary, the contributions of the paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 概括地说,本文件的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We propose a two-stage pipeline to train a robust enhancer from unpaired data. The first stage is a cycle-consistent style-transfer model to learn HQ → \rightarrow LQ from unaligned real clinical pairs. It provides pixel-aligned synthetic LQ–HQ data to train the enhancer in the second stage. The HQ images are never modified and ensure the supervision target is free of anatomical hallucination. • We extend PiSA-SR with a degradation-conditioned correction matrix C ⁡ ( 𝒅 ) C(\boldsymbol{d}) inserted between A A and B B in both LoRA branches. This input-adaptive update enables the model to handle the complex, spatially varying speckle noise characteristic of handheld ultrasound. • We report diverse no-reference metrics on the real-world USenhance2023 dataset. We focus particularly on the FID metric. It measures the distributional distance between enhanced outputs and authentic HQ scans. Our method achieves a 16.7% better FID than the strongest baseline. The result confirms the complementary role in handling degradation on ultrasound images.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提议分两个阶段进行管道培训,以便从未经证实的数据中培训一个强大的增强器。 第一阶段是一个循环一致的风格转换模型,用来从不对齐的真临床配对中学习HQ ~\右旋LQ. 它提供像素对齐的合成LQQHQ数据,在第二阶段训练增强器. 总部的图像从未修改过,并确保监督目标没有解剖幻觉。 我们在LORA两个分支的A和B之间插入了一个带有降解条件的更正矩阵C → (d) C(\boldsymbol{d})。 这种输入适应性更新使模型能够处理手持超声波的复杂、空间变化的光谱噪音特征。 我们报告了关于现实世界USenhance2023数据集的各种无参考指标。 我们特别侧重于FID指标。 它测量增强产出与真实的总部扫描之间的分布距离. 我们的方法比最强的基线能达到16.7%的能量。 结果证实了在处理超声波图像降解方面的互补作用。

blocks.en: We propose a two-stage pipeline to train a robust enhancer from unpaired data. The first stage is a cycle-consistent style-transfer model to learn HQ → \rightarrow LQ from unaligned real clinical pairs. It provides pixel-aligned synthetic LQ–HQ data to train the enhancer in the second stage. The HQ images are never modified and ensure the supervision target is free of anatomical hallucination.
blocks.zh: 我们提议分两个阶段进行管道培训,以便从未经证实的数据中培训一个强大的增强器。 第一阶段是一个循环一致的风格转换模型,用来从不对齐的真临床配对中学习HQ ~\右旋LQ. 它提供像素对齐的合成LQQHQ数据,在第二阶段训练增强器. 总部的图像从未修改过,并确保监督对象没有解剖幻觉.

blocks.en: We extend PiSA-SR with a degradation-conditioned correction matrix C ⁡ ( 𝒅 ) C(\boldsymbol{d}) inserted between A A and B B in both LoRA branches. This input-adaptive update enables the model to handle the complex, spatially varying speckle noise characteristic of handheld ultrasound.
blocks.zh: 我们在LORA两个分支的A和B之间插入了一个带有降解条件的更正矩阵C → (d) C(\boldsymbol{d})。 这种输入适应性更新使模型能够处理手持超声波的复杂,空间差异的光谱噪声特征.

blocks.en: We report diverse no-reference metrics on the real-world USenhance2023 dataset. We focus particularly on the FID metric. It measures the distributional distance between enhanced outputs and authentic HQ scans. Our method achieves a 16.7% better FID than the strongest baseline. The result confirms the complementary role in handling degradation on ultrasound images.
blocks.zh: 我们报告了关于现实世界USenhance2023数据集的各种无参考指标。 我们特别侧重于FID指标。 它测量增强产出与真实的总部扫描之间的分布距离. 我们的方法比最强的基线能达到16.7%的能量。 结果证实了在处理超声波图像降解方面的互补作用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Image Super-Resolution and Degradation Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.1 图像超解析和降解模型

blocks.en: Deep super-resolution has progressed from CNN-based methods such as EDSR [ 10 ] to real-world SR pipelines, and more recently to diffusion-based models. Within the real-world SR line, each method adopts a different degradation assumption, where Real-ESRGAN [ 14 ] uses high-order degradation, DARSR [ 19 ] performs test-time adaptation, and PDM [ 11 ] adopts a probabilistic degradation model. On the diffusion side, OSEDiff [ 16 ] distills a latent diffusion model into a one-step restorer, and PiSA-SR introduces dual-LoRA branches for adjustable fidelity–perception trade-offs. Across these paradigms, performance on real inputs still hinges on whether the assumed degradation matches the real one; when it does not, architectural refinement alone cannot close the gap.
blocks.zh: 深度超分辨率已经从基于CNN的方法,如EDSR[10],发展到现实世界的SR管道,以及更近的推广模型. 在现实世界的SR线内,每一种方法都采用不同的降解假设,即Real-ESRGAN[14]使用高序降解,DARSR[19]进行测试时间适应,PDM[11]采用概率降解模型. 在扩散方面,OSEDIff [16] 将潜在的扩散模型提炼成一个一步恢复器,而PISA-SR引入了可调整的忠诚-感知权衡的双LORA分支. 在这些范式中,实际投入的绩效仍然取决于假设的退化是否与真实的退化相符;如果不相符,仅靠建筑改进无法弥合差距。

blocks.en: 2.2 Ultrasound-Specific Image Enhancement
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 超声波特定图像增强

blocks.en: A similar picture emerges in ultrasound-specific enhancement. Zhou et al. [ 20 ] proposed GAN-based architectures for handheld ultrasound. Jiang et al. [ 7 ] designed a two-stage wavelet-decomposition degradation pipeline. Khan et al. [ 8 ] proposed a self-supervised physics-guided degradation model. Despite their architectural differences, all of them still train on synthetically degraded LQ images, which limits how well they generalize to real handheld output.
blocks.zh: 在超声波特异性增强中也出现了类似的情况. 周 et等编. [20]提议手持式超声波基于GAN的架构. 蒋等. [7]设计了两级波浪分解降解管道. 汗等编. [8]提出了自我监督的物理制导降解模型. 尽管它们的建筑不同,但它们都仍然在合成退化的LQ图像上进行训练,这限制了它们普遍到真正的手持输出的程度.

blocks.en: 2.3 Unpaired Translation: Enhancement vs. Degradation
blocks.zh: 2.3 未授权翻译:增强与退化

blocks.en: CycleGAN [ 21 ] -based unpaired translation has been widely applied in ultrasound. Huang et al. [ 5 ] adopted it for cross-center ultrasound domain normalization. However, an unconstrained generator used as an enhancer can create plausible-looking anatomy that is not really there. This hallucination problem is unacceptable in medical imaging.
blocks.zh: CycleGAN [21] ——基于非保修的翻译在超声波中被广泛应用. 黄等. [5]把它用于跨中心超声域正常化. 然而,一个作为增强器的不受约束的生成器可以产生看起来似是而非的解剖学. 这种幻觉问题在医学成像中是不可接受的.

blocks.en: Our work takes the opposite direction. We repurpose unpaired translation as a degradation simulator in the HQ → \rightarrow LQ direction. The generator only needs to simulate quality loss, and the HQ training targets remain untouched real data. This removes the hallucination risk on the HQ side, while still exploiting the generator’s ability to learn complex, device-specific degradation from unaligned data.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作方向相反。 我们重新将未发音的翻译作为总部的退化模拟器 \\ 右旋 LQ 方向。 发电机只需要模拟质量损失,而总部的培训目标仍然未受影响。 这消除了总部一方的幻觉风险,同时仍在利用发电机从不相通的数据中学习复杂、特定设备退化的能力。

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en: Section 3.1 introduces how the pixel-aligned dataset is created, and Section 3.2 discusses how the enhancer is trained.

blocks.en: 3.2 DDG-LoRA Enhancer
blocks.zh: 3.2 DDG-LORA增强器

blocks.en: Our enhancement model is built on PiSA-SR [ 13 ] , whose strong diffusion prior and dual-LoRA mechanism provide a suitable starting point for restoring the compound degradations of handheld ultrasound. PiSA-SR attaches two LoRA modules to the frozen diffusion UNet and trains them in two stages. A pixel-level LoRA Δ ​ θ pix \Delta\theta_{\text{pix}} is trained first under an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} reconstruction loss for pixel-level fidelity. A semantic-level LoRA Δ ​ θ sem \Delta\theta_{\text{sem}} is trained afterwards under a combined LPIPS [ 18 ] and classifier score distillation ( ℒ CSD \mathcal{L}_{\text{CSD}} ) objective, while Δ ​ θ pix \Delta\theta_{\text{pix}} stays frozen. Both LoRA modules follow the standard LoRA form, in which a frozen base weight W ∈ ℝ m × n W\!\in\!\mathbb{R}^{m\times n} is replaced by W LoRA = W + A ​ B , A ∈ ℝ m × r , B ∈ ℝ r × n , W_{\text{LoRA}}=W+AB,\quad A\!\in\!\mathbb{R}^{m\times r},\ B\!\in\!\mathbb{R}^{r\times n}, (2) with r ≪ min ⁡ ( m , n ) r\!\ll\!\min(m,n) , so only the two small factorizations are trainable while the UNet and VAE weights remain frozen. blocks.en: The second modification addresses PiSA-SR’s Stage-2 objective. The text-prompt extractor behind ℒ CSD \mathcal{L}_{\text{CSD}} is trained on natural images; on ultrasound scans it produces out-of-domain concepts that carry little useful information for the diffusion prior. blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We partition the USenhance2023 collection [ 3 ] into 840 training and 210 test samples. The collection contains 1,050 patient-matched yet unaligned clinical ultrasound pairs across five organs. Each pair couples an LQ scan with an HQ scan, both at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 resolution . To establish pixel-aligned supervision without requiring prior spatial correspondence, we train a CycleDiff-based style-transfer degrader G G on the 840 unaligned pairs through three stages. Stage 1 fits a per-domain AutoencoderKL initialized from kl-f4 weights with learning rate decaying from 5 × 10 − 6 5{\times}10^{-6} to 10 − 6 10^{-6} over 50k steps at an effective batch size of 16 , producing the per-domain latent spaces used by the later stages. Stage 2 freezes those latent spaces and trains a per-domain unconditional LDM within each via an EDM-preconditioned DhariwalUNet with learning rate decaying from 10 − 4 10^{-4} to 10 − 5 10^{-5} over 400k steps at an effective batch size of 12 . Stage 3 stacks a timestep-conditioned ResNet generator together with an N-layer PatchGAN above the two LDMs from Stage 2 to obtain G G , with translator learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} and LDM fine-tune learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} over 160k steps at an effective batch size of 24 . The optimized G G is then applied to the 840 HQ training images to synthesize aligned LQ counterparts at the same 256 × 256 256{\times}256 resolution , forming the USenhance2023-Aligned training set. A 210-pair USenhance2023-Aligned test set is also produced for the held-out split. Because G G only synthesizes the LQ side, the target HQ images remain unmodified throughout to keep the supervision target free of anatomical hallucination, while the synthesized LQ side faithfully reproduces device-specific degradation.
blocks.zh: 我们把USenhance2023收集的[3] 分为840个训练和210个测试样本. 该集包含1,050个患者配对但相互不匹配的临床超声波对,跨越5个器官. 每对夫妇用HQ扫描一次,都以256×256×256}256分辨率. 为了建立像素对齐的监管而不需要事先的空间对齐,我们在840对不对齐的对齐上训练一种基于CycleDiff的风格转移式降解器G,经过三个阶段. 第1阶段适合每个域的自动编码器KL从kl-f4权重初始化,学习速率衰变从5×10−6 5}10×6×6}10×6}到10−6 10×10×6}超过50k步,有效批量大小为16,产生后期使用的每个域的潜在空格. 第二阶段冻结了这些潜在空间,并通过一个EDM预设的DhariwalUNet,在每个领域内培训一个无条件的LDM,学习率从10 - 4 10 - 4 5 10 - 5 5 个步骤下降至400多步,有效批量规模为12 个。 第3阶段堆放一个有时间步态的ResNet生成器,加上一个N级PatchGAN在从第2阶段开始的两个LDM上方,以获得GG,其中翻译学习率为10−4 10→4},LDM微调学习率为10−5 10→5}超过160k级,有效批量大小为24. 然后,优化后的GG应用到840HQ训练图像中,以相同的256×256\256}256分辨率合成对齐的LQ对应器,形成USenhance2023-Acent训练集. 还生产了一套210-pair USenhance2023-Acontent测试装置,用于牵引分离. 由于GG只合成LQ侧面,目标HQ图像在整个过程中保持不修改,以保持监督目标无解剖幻觉,而合成的LQ侧面忠实地复制了设备特有的降解.

blocks.en: On the USenhance2023-Aligned set, DDG-LoRA is trained with SD-2.1-base as the pretrained backbone and warm-started by the dual LoRA checkpoints provided by PiSA-SR [ 13 ] . The synthesized LQ images are bicubically downsampled by 4 × 4{\times} to 64 × 64 64{\times}64 to match the standard 4 × 4{\times} super-resolution setting shared by all baselines. Training adopts single-step diffusion with residual learning, with a learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5{\times}10^{-5} over 12,500 steps at an effective batch size of 2 . The first 4,000 steps optimize only the pixel LoRA before switching to the semantic LoRA. At inference, λ pix \lambda_{\text{pix}} and λ sem \lambda_{\text{sem}} are both set to the default value of 1 1 .

blocks.en: The reported experimental results are computed on the 210 unaligned real-world LQ–HQ pairs from the USenhance2023 test split, rather than directly using the pixel-aligned synthetic USenhance2023-Aligned test set. Because pixel-aligned ground truth (GT) is unavailable, the proposed method is evaluated with five widely used metrics that do not depend on pixel-level correspondence. FID [ 4 ] measures the distributional discrepancy between enhanced outputs and authentic HQ scans in a deep feature space, where lower values indicate closer alignment with real clinical data. NIQE [ 12 ] scores how closely an output follows natural-scene statistics, with lower values denoting a more natural appearance. PI (perceptual index) [ 1 ] aggregates no-reference statistics into a single perceptual score, for which lower is better. Tenengrad [ 9 ] reflects gradient-based sharpness and rewards images with well-preserved anatomical edges. Entropy quantifies the richness of structural details, with higher values indicating more informative content. Among the five metrics, FID is the most important for ultrasound enhancement. Because FID is the only metric that compares the enhanced outputs against the real HQ distribution, it reveals over-sharpened yet structurally hallucinated artifacts that non-reference metrics fail to detect.
blocks.zh: 所报告的实验结果是从USenhance2023测试分裂出来的210对不对齐的现实世界LQQHQ对计算出来的,而不是直接使用像素对齐的合成USenhance2023-Acent测试集. 由于像素对齐的地面真伪(GT)是无法获取的,因此建议的方法用五个广泛使用的不依赖于像素级对应的度量衡来评价. FID [4] 测量一个深层特征空间中增强的输出和真实的总部扫描之间的分布差异,其中较低的值表示与真实的临床数据更加一致. NIQE [12] 评分一个输出如何紧跟自然景色统计,较低的值表示一个更自然的外观. PI(知觉指数)[1]将无参考统计汇总为单一知觉分数,分数更低. Tenengrad [9] 反映了基于梯度的锐度,并奖励具有保存良好的解剖边缘的图像. Entropy将结构细节的丰富性量化,更高的数值表明内容更加丰富. 在五个度量衡中,FID是超声波增强最重要的. 由于FID是唯一一个将增强的输出量与总部实际分布量进行比较的度量,它揭示出过度断裂但结构上有幻觉的文物,非参考度量无法检测到.

blocks.en: 4.2 Impact of Training Data on Enhancement Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训数据对提高绩效的影响

blocks.en: This section aims to evaluate the effect of training data on DDG-LoRA. We construct five paired training datasets, each generated by a different degradation pipeline, and train DDG-LoRA on each dataset independently. realesrgan_deg [ 14 ] is a widely adopted general-purpose hand-crafted pipeline originally developed for natural images and now serves as a common reference for synthesized degradations across imaging modalities. physics_guided_deg [ 8 ] and usbsr_deg [ 7 ] are hand-crafted pipelines proposed in prior ultrasound enhancement studies and tailored to the ultrasound domain. The former simulates ultrasound-specific artifacts from acoustic physics, while the latter operates in the frequency domain to capture characteristic ultrasound noise. ultrasound_deg is another hand-crafted pipeline that we propose for comparison, combining blur, downsampling, Gaussian noise, and speckle noise. Finally, USenhance2023-Aligned is our style-driven training set learned directly from real handheld LQ scans.
blocks.zh: 本节旨在评价培训数据对DDG-LORA的影响。 我们构建了五个对齐的培训数据集,每个数据集由不同的降解管道生成,并在每个数据集上独立培训DDG-LORA. realesrgan_deg [14] 是一条被广泛采用的通用手动管道,最初是为自然图像开发的,现在作为各种成像模式合成降解的共同参考。 物理_导电_deg [8] 和 usbsr_deg [7] 是先前超声波增强研究中建议的手动管道,适合超声波领域. 前者模拟来自声学的超声波特异性文物,后者则在频率域中操作以捕捉特征超声波噪声. 超声波是另一个手动管道, 我们建议进行比较, 结合模糊, 下取样,高斯噪音, 和光谱噪音。 最后,USenhance2023-Aregn是我们从真正的手持LQ扫描直接学到的风格驱动的训练集.

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the quantitative results in a real-world clinical setting. Among the five training sources, USenhance2023-Aligned (ours) ranks first on FID, PI, Tenengrad, and Entropy, and second on NIQE. The FID drops from 127.01, the lowest-FID hand-crafted baseline given by realesrgan_deg , to 99.00, indicating that the enhanced outputs lie closer to the distribution of authentic HQ scans. This finding suggests that learning the degradation directly from real handheld scans captures statistical characteristics that hand-crafted pipelines cannot reproduce.
blocks.zh: 表1列出现实世界临床环境的定量结果。 在五个培训来源中,USenhance2023-Acent (ours)在FID,PI,Tenenengrad和Entropy排名第一,在NIQE排名第二. FID从resergan_deg给出的最低FID手工基线127.01下降到99.00,表明增强的产出更接近于真实的总部扫描的分布. 这一发现表明,直接从真正的手持扫描中学习降解,可以捕捉到手动管道无法复制的统计特征.

blocks.en: We further compare our proposed DDG-LoRA against seven baselines representing different paradigms. EDSR [ 10 ] is a conventional CNN-based SR model. CycleSR [ 2 ] performs unsupervised SR through an indirect supervised path with cycle consistency. DARSR [ 19 ] tackles blind SR by regressing a degradation-adaptive correction filter, whereas PDM [ 11 ] explicitly learns the underlying degradation distribution. USBSR [ 7 ] is specifically designed for handheld ultrasound image enhancement, employing a two-stage degradation-based unpaired training scheme. OSEDiff [ 16 ] and PiSA-SR [ 13 ] are both one-step diffusion-based SR models built on a pretrained stable diffusion backbone, with OSEDiff focusing on efficient real-world SR and PiSA-SR introducing a dual-LoRA design for pixel-level and semantic-level adjustability.
blocks.zh: 我们还将我们提议的DDG-LORA与代表不同范式的七个基线进行比较。 EDSR[10]是一个传统的基于CNN的SR模型. CycleSR [2] 通过周期一致性的间接监督路径进行无监督的SR. DARSR[19]通过倒退适应降解的校正滤波器解决失明的SR问题,而PDM[11]则明确了解潜在的降解分布. USBSR [7]是专门为手持超声波图像增强而设计的,采用了基于降解的两阶段无保训练计划. OSEdiff [16] 和 PISA-SR [13] 都是一种基于一步的传播的SR模型,建立在预先训练的稳定的传播主干上,OSEdiff专注于高效的现实世界SR和PISA-SR引入了像素级和语义级可调性的双LORA设计.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Overall comparison of different enhancement methods on the real-world USenhance2023 test set. Red = best, Blue = second best.
blocks.zh: 表2:现实世界USenhance2023测试集不同增强方法的总体比较. 红色=最佳,蓝色=第二名.

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the quantitative comparison on the real-world USenhance2023 test set. The non-diffusion baselines (EDSR, CycleSR, DARSR, PDM, and USBSR) consistently lag behind on most metrics, reflecting their limited capacity to model complex real-world degradations. Among them, USBSR delivers the relatively strongest numbers, since it is specifically designed for handheld ultrasound image enhancement. Within the diffusion-based group, PiSA-SR slightly outperforms OSEDiff thanks to its design. In contrast, our DDG-LoRA consistently outperforms every baseline across all five metrics, achieving the best FID (99.00), NIQE (5.619), PI (4.764), Tenengrad (0.1043), and Entropy (6.861). The FID score deserves particular attention, since FID measures the distributional distance between enhanced outputs and authentic HQ scans , and therefore serves as a holistic indicator of perceptual realism. Our FID of 99.00 represents a 16.7% reduction over the strongest baseline (118.87), indicating that the distribution of DDG-LoRA’s enhanced outputs is closest to that of authentic HQ scans, which is precisely the property our framework is designed to optimize.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了现实世界USenhance2023测试集的定量比较. 非扩散基线(EDSR、CycleSR、DARSR、PDM和USBSR)在大多数衡量标准上一直滞后,反映了它们模拟复杂的现实世界退化的能力有限。 其中USBSR提供相对最强的数字,因为它是专门为手持超声波图像增强而设计的. 在基于扩散的组内,PISA-SR因其设计而略高于OSEdiff. 相比之下,我们的DDG-LORA在所有5个度量标准中始终比每个基准都高,达到了最好的FID(99.00),NIQE(5.619),PI(4.764),Tenenengrad(0.1043)和Entropy(6.861). FID得分值得特别关注,因为FID衡量增强产出与真实的总部扫描之间的分布距离,因此是洞察现实的整体指标。 我们99.00的FID比最强基线(118.87)减少了16.7%,这表明DDG-LORA增强产出的分布最接近于真正的总部扫描,而这正是我们框架旨在优化的属性。

blocks.en: Fig. 3 presents the corresponding qualitative comparison on a real-world USenhance2023 sample. EDSR, CycleSR, and PDM produce textures that diverge from the GT and exhibit obvious artifacts. DARSR is overly conservative and yields a blurry output. USBSR sharpens slightly more than DARSR but remains noticeably blurry. OSEDiff and PiSA-SR strike a better balance between fidelity and realism, yet their texture details remain visibly different from the GT. Our DDG-LoRA most closely matches the GT in characteristics such as grayscale intensity distribution, contrast, and texture detail. This qualitative observation is consistent with the quantitative comparison.
blocks.zh: 图3对现实世界的USenhance-2023样本作了相应的质量比较。 EDSR、CycleSR和PDM生产与GT不同的纹理,并展示明显的文物。 DARSR过于保守,输出模糊. USBSR的磨度略高于DARSR,但仍明显模糊不清. OSEdiff和PISA-SR在忠诚与现实之间达成更好的平衡,然而它们的纹理细节仍然明显不同于GT. 我们的DDG-LORA在灰度强度分布,对比度,纹理细节等特征上最接近GT. 这种定性观察与定量比较一致.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study: Effect of Degradation Conditioning
blocks.zh: 4.4 关联性研究:退化条件的影响

blocks.en: We perform an ablation study to isolate the contribution of the degradation-conditioning term C ⁡ ( 𝒅 ) C(\boldsymbol{d}) by comparing the full DDG-LoRA model against a variant in which each DG-LoRA module is reverted to a standard LoRA. Both models are trained on the USenhance2023-Aligned dataset under identical experimental settings to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们进行一项减缩研究,通过将完整的DDG-LORA模型与每个DG-LORA模块恢复为标准LORA的变体进行比较,以隔离降解空调术语C ⁡(d) C(\boldsymbol{d})的贡献. 这两个模型在相同的实验设置下都接受了USenhance2023-Acental数据集的培训,以确保公平比较.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Ablation study on the degradation conditioning module in DDG-LoRA. Bold red indicates the better result for each metric.
blocks.zh: 表3:关于DDG-LORA中降解调节模块的研究。 粗体红色表示每个度量的较好结果.

blocks.en: The quantitative results in Table 3 show that adding the DDG module yields better scores on PI, Tenengrad, and Entropy, while FID stays essentially unchanged at 99.00 against 98.98 and NIQE narrowly trails at 5.619 against 5.589. On balance, the gains from DDG-LoRA outweigh this small loss, confirming that the module indeed contributes to ultrasound image restoration.
blocks.zh: 表3的定量结果显示,增加DDG模块对PI、Tennegrad和Entropy的分数较好,而FID则基本上保持不变,分别为99.00和98.98;NIQE小径5.619和5.589。 总的来说,DDG-LORA的收益超过了这一小损失,证实该模块确实有助于超声波图像修复.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a two-stage framework to train an enhancer from an unpaired LQ–HQ dataset. This method addresses the lack of pixel-aligned LQ–HQ pairs and the domain gap left by synthetic degradation in supervised handheld ultrasound enhancement. Stage one trains a CycleDiff-based style-transfer model on unaligned clinical data to synthesize pixel-aligned pairs. Stage two introduces DDG-LoRA, which extends PiSA-SR by inserting a degradation-conditioned correction matrix C ⁡ ( 𝒅 ) C(\boldsymbol{d}) between A A and B B in each LoRA branch to adapt the enhancement to input-specific speckle and blur levels.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出一个两阶段框架,从未发售的LQQHQ数据集中培训增强器. 这种方法解决了缺乏像素对齐的LQQHQ配对和在受监督的手持超声增强中合成降解留下的域间隙. 第一阶段在不对齐的临床数据上训练一种基于CycleDiff的风格转移模型,以合成像素对齐的对齐. 第二阶段引入DDG-LORA,它通过在每个LORA分支A和B之间插入一个可降解条件的校正矩阵C → (d) C(\boldsymbol{d})来扩展PISA-SR,以使增强适应输入特定的光谱和模糊的级别.

blocks.en: A comprehensive evaluation on the real-world USenhance2023 test set demonstrates the effectiveness of both contributions. On the FID metric, our method yields a 16.7% reduction over the strongest baseline . Ablation study points out that DDG-LoRA provides a further 3.7% Tenengrad gain, and the combined system ranks first on all five no-reference metrics against seven representative baselines.
blocks.zh: 对现实世界的USenhance2023测试集进行的综合评价,显示了这两种贡献的有效性。 我们的方法比最强的基线减少16.7%。 校对研究指出,DDG-LORA提供了3.7%的Tennegrad增益,综合系统在所有五个无参考度量中,相对于7个代表性基线排名第一.
